name: planwise
description: Agentic project management — plan, execute, review, and track projects with structured workflows

agent_guard.title: Agent guard
agent_guard.description: Checks planwise:task-runner dispatches only; other agents and calls pass untouched. report (default): log each finding and let the call proceed. deny: refuse a background task-runner spawn, refuse a bare cd or file-read Bash verb inside a task-runner, and block a task-runner that stops unfinished. The spawn-prompt check only reports, at either value.
